## Introduction

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(magrittr)
library(readxl)

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```

Here, I will make the figure for the heatmap summairising the changes to the LysoDLB genes across several RNAseq datasets

# Import toptables
```{r}
all.toptable.filepaths = list.files(
  "data/public data/processed", 
  pattern = "toptable", 
  full.names = T) 

toptables = list(
  DLB.ACC = read_csv("data/public data/processed/syn5239400_toptable_DLBvCont_hs_bulk_ACC.csv", 
                     col_select = -1) %>% 
    mutate(
      FDR = p.adjust(pval, "fdr"), 
      .after = "pval"
    ), 
  
  DLB.PFC = read_csv("data/public data/processed/GSE150696_toptable_DLBvCont_hs_bulk_PFC.csv",   
                     col_select = -1), 
  
  MPSIIIA.wholeBrain = read_xlsx("data/public data/processed/GSE244310_toptable_lysoMPSIIIAC_dr_bulk_brain.xlsx", sheet = "MPS IIIA"), 
  
  MPSIIIB.wholeBrain = read_xlsx("data/public data/processed/GSE242370_toptable_lysoMPSIIIB_dr_bulk_brain.xlsx"), 
  
  MPSIIIC.wholeBrain = read_xlsx("data/public data/processed/GSE244310_toptable_lysoMPSIIIAC_dr_bulk_brain.xlsx", sheet = "MPS IIIC"), 
  
  MPSIIIB.larvae = read_xlsx("data/public data/processed/GSE217196_toptable_lysoMPSIIIB_dr_bulkLarvae.xlsx")
  
) %>% 
  # add in DLB ACC snRNAseq
  c(readRDS("data/public data/processed/GSE178146_toptable_DLB_hs_ACC_snRNAseq.rds") %>% 
  .[names(.) %>% str_detect("DLB")] %>% 
    set_names(
      names(.) %>% 
        str_replace(
          pattern = "DLB_", replacement = "DLB.ACC_"
        )
    )
  ) %>% 
  # add in MPS IIIA snRNAseq cortex
  c(
    readRDS("data/public data/processed/GSE278451_toptable_lysoMPSIIIA_mm_forebrain_snRNAseq.rds")
    ) %>% 
  set_names(
   names(.) %>% 
     str_replace("^(.+)_(SgshKO)$", "\\2_\\1")
  )

# omit some toptables
toptables <- toptables[setdiff(names(toptables), "SgshKO_Astro")] # only N = 1 in the KO
```

## convert zf to human
```{r}

convertzf2Hs = function(toptable) {
  
  zf2hs = homologene::homologene(
  inTax = "7955", # zebrafish
  outTax = "9606", # human
  toptable$symbol
  ) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    symbol = `7955`, hs_gene_name = `9606`
  )
  
  toptable %>% 
    left_join(zf2hs) %>%
    dplyr::select(-symbol) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    dplyr::select(symbol = hs_gene_name, everything()) %>%
    group_by(symbol) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = tibble(DE, abs(logFC)), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
}
  
toptables$MPSIIIB.wholeBrain <- convertzf2Hs(toptables$MPSIIIB.wholeBrain)  
toptables$MPSIIIA.wholeBrain <- convertzf2Hs(toptables$MPSIIIA.wholeBrain)  
toptables$MPSIIIC.wholeBrain <- convertzf2Hs(toptables$MPSIIIC.wholeBrain)  
toptables$MPSIIIB.larvae <- convertzf2Hs(toptables$MPSIIIB.larvae)  
 
```

## convert mouse to human
```{r}
convertMm2Hs = function(toptable) {
  
  mm2hs = homologene::homologene(
  inTax = "10090", # mouse
  outTax = "9606", # human
  toptable$symbol
  ) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    symbol = `10090`, hs_gene_name = `9606`
  )
  
  toptable %>% 
    left_join(mm2hs) %>%
    dplyr::select(-symbol) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    dplyr::select(symbol = hs_gene_name, everything()) %>%
    group_by(symbol) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = tibble(DE, abs(logFC)), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
}

toptables$SgshKO_OPC <- convertMm2Hs(toptables$SgshKO_OPC)
toptables$SgshKO_Oligo <- convertMm2Hs(toptables$SgshKO_Oligo)
toptables$SgshKO_NeuronMix <- convertMm2Hs(toptables$SgshKO_NeuronMix)
toptables$SgshKO_NeuronIn <- convertMm2Hs(toptables$SgshKO_NeuronIn)
toptables$SgshKO_NeuronEx <- convertMm2Hs(toptables$SgshKO_NeuronEx)
toptables$SgshKO_Immune <- convertMm2Hs(toptables$SgshKO_Immune)
```



# import lysoDLB genes
```{r}
### obtain the genes in the subnetworks
node_metadata <- 
  list.files(path = "data/results/adultchildsubtypes v2", 
             pattern = "overlapping_nodes_metadata", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  set_names(
    str_replace(., 
                pattern = "/overlapping_nodes_metadata.csv",
                replacement = ""
    ) %>% 
      str_remove(
        pattern = paste0("data/results/adultchildsubtypes v2", "/")
      )
  ) %>%   
  map(read.csv) %>%
  imap(~ mutate(.x, comparison = .y))

cluster.gprofiler.results <- 
  list.files(path = "data/results/adultchildsubtypes v2", 
             pattern = "gprofiler", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  set_names(
    str_replace(., 
                pattern = "/gprofiler_analysis_results.csv",
                replacement = ""
    ) %>% 
      str_remove(
        pattern = paste0("data/results/adultchildsubtypes v2", "/")
      )
  ) %>%   
  map(read.csv) %>%
  imap(~ mutate(.x, comparison = .y))

network.genes.cluster.DLB <- 
  cluster.gprofiler.results$CD_1A_lyso_DLB %>% 
  dplyr::select(Cluster, genes) %>% 
  mutate(genes = str_split(genes, " ")) %>% 
  deframe()
```

# heatmap building

```{r}
dat <- toptables %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "dataset") %>%
  dplyr::filter(symbol %in% node_metadata$CD_1A_lyso_DLB$X)

# logFC matrix: genes x datasets
fc <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol, dataset, logFC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = logFC) %>%
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>%
  as.matrix()

# DE matrix, same shape, for the asterisks
de <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol, dataset, DE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = DE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("symbol") %>%
  as.matrix()
de <- de[rownames(fc), colnames(fc)]  

lim <- max(abs(fc), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

# only retain genes DE in at least one dataset
keep <- rownames(de)[rowSums(de, na.rm = TRUE) >= 2]

fc <- fc[keep, ]
de <- de[keep, ]

# compute disances. 
d <- dist(fc)                        # pairwise-complete; some entries may be NA
d[is.na(d)] <- max(d, na.rm = TRUE)  # genes sharing no datasets = maximally distant
row_hc <- hclust(d, method = "average")

# column annotation

col_meta <- tribble(
  ~dataset,               ~species,     ~brain_region, ~age,  ~disease_type, ~type,
  "DLB.ACC",            "Human",      "ACC",         "post mortem", "DLB",  "bulk",
  "DLB.PFC",            "Human",      "PFC",         "post mortem", "DLB",  "bulk",
  "MPSIIIA.wholeBrain", "Zebrafish", "whole brain",   "3 mo",  "lyso",  "bulk",
  "MPSIIIB.wholeBrain", "Zebrafish", "whole brain",   "6 mo",  "lyso",  "bulk",
  "MPSIIIC.wholeBrain", "Zebrafish", "whole brain",   "3 mo",    "lyso",  "bulk",
  "MPSIIIB.larvae",    "Zebrafish",  "whole larvae",   "7 days",    "lyso",  "bulk",

  "DLB.ACC_Astrocyte", "Human",      "ACC",         "post mortem", "DLB",  "snRNA-seq",
  "DLB.ACC_Microglia", "Human",      "ACC",         "post mortem", "DLB",  "snRNA-seq",
  "DLB.ACC_Neuron_Ex", "Human",      "ACC",         "post mortem", "DLB",  "snRNA-seq",
  "DLB.ACC_Neuron_In", "Human",      "ACC",         "post mortem", "DLB",  "snRNA-seq",
  "DLB.ACC_Oligodendrocyte", "Human",      "ACC",         "post mortem", "DLB",  "snRNA-seq",
  "DLB.ACC_OPC", "Human",      "ACC",         "post mortem", "DLB",  "snRNA-seq", 
  
  "SgshKO_Immune", "Mouse", "forebrain", "6 mo", "lyso",  "snRNA-seq", 
  "SgshKO_NeuronEx", "Mouse", "forebrain", "6 mo", "lyso",  "snRNA-seq", 
  "SgshKO_NeuronIn", "Mouse", "forebrain", "6 mo", "lyso",  "snRNA-seq", 
  "SgshKO_NeuronMix", "Mouse", "forebrain", "6 mo", "lyso",  "snRNA-seq",  
  "SgshKO_Oligo", "Mouse", "forebrain", "6 mo", "lyso",  "snRNA-seq", 
  "SgshKO_OPC", "Mouse", "forebrain", "6 mo", "lyso",  "snRNA-seq", 
  
)
col_meta <- col_meta %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(fc), dataset)) %>%   # force same order as matrix columns
  column_to_rownames("dataset")


ann_cols <- list(
  species      = c(Human = "#4C72B0", Mouse = "#DD8452", Zebrafish = "#55A868"),
  # brain_region = c(ACC = "#8172B3", Forebrain = "#C44E52", `Whole brain` = "#937860"),
  disease_type      = c(DLB = "#DA8BC3", lyso = "#CCB974"), 
  type      = c(bulk = "grey70", `snRNA-seq` = "black")
  # age left to a continuous scale below, or add discrete levels here
)
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df  = col_meta,
  col = ann_cols,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

Heatmap(
  fc,                                # original matrix, NAs intact
  name = "logFC",
  col = col_fun,
  na_col = "grey50",                 # NAs render grey
  cluster_rows = row_hc,             # precomputed, NA-safe tree
  cluster_columns = F,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    if (isTRUE(de[i, j])) grid.text("x", x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
  },
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  
   top_annotation = col_ha
)
```
